rationale: The assistant immediately confirmed the recall risk and told the customer to unplug and stop using the dryer, then pointed to Whirlpool's checker and helpline with model and serial. It was slightly over-confident in saying the IDV75 is definitely affected and in asserting that the machine is 'at least 11 years old', but it did not claim the unit was unmodified. The advice to look at the rating plate and clean the filter is minor, and the mum cannot pull the machine out, though this is low risk since the unit is unplugged. No part was recommended.
